champion.tips: FIDDLESTICKS TIPS AND TRICKS When low, channel your W in a big minion wave for maximum healing. Place a Control Ward in the bottom lane bush and hide in there. When the enemy overextends, channel your R and engage. Your E has a long-range, so try to poke the enemy from maximum distance to make it harder for them to trade back with you.
champion.builds: THE BEST FIDDLESTICKS BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Fiddlesticks Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Cheap Shot and Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Malignance. For your last 3 items, you should build Zhonya's Hourglass, Liandry's Torment and finish with Morellonomicon. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 50.7% winrate over 1 859 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Cheap Shot with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Celestial Opposition as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Malignance as a third item. You want to finish the build with Zhonya's Hourglass, Liandry's Torment and Rabadon's Deathcap. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 49.3% win rate across 363 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Fiddlesticks Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Dark Harvest, Taste of Blood, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Gathering Storm as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Malignance as third item. The last 3 options are Liandry's Torment, Zhonya's Hourglass and Shadowflame. The ability order for this build is W - Q - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 53.7% win rate over 270 matches played. Situational Fiddlesticks Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Fiddlesticks build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Fiddlesticks runes page.
